effects.does: It copies the associated value to the clipboard.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record changes.
effects.check: Click Copy and verify that the intended value can be pasted elsewhere.

effects.does: It copies the value associated with the copy icon to the clipboard.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record changes.
effects.check: Click the icon and verify that its associated value is available from the clipboard.

effects.does: It opens the Clara assistant for the current project.
effects.affects: It may start an analysis or awarding-related assistant flow, but does not directly change the event record.
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify that the Clara interface opens for this project.

effects.does: It starts creating a new version of the project.
effects.affects: It creates a new project-version draft context without changing the current version.
effects.check: Click Create New Version when version creation is allowed and verify that the creation screen opens with the current project context.

effects.does: It opens the project communication hub.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data changes; it only opens project messaging.
effects.check: Click Messages and verify that the communication interface opens when communication is allowed.

effects.does: It hides the available QCS fields or columns.
effects.affects: Only the current Master QCS view is changed; event and bid data remain unchanged.
effects.check: Click Hide fields and verify that the QCS fields are no longer displayed.

effects.does: It downloads a report for the displayed project or QCS data.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record changes; it only produces an export.
effects.check: Click Download Report and verify that a report download starts or a download prompt appears.

effects.does: It starts the awarding flow for the current lot.
effects.affects: It moves the project from bid comparison toward awarding and may open a bid-justification dialog when a pending justification request exists.
effects.check: Click Start Awarding and verify that the awarding screen opens, or that the justification dialog appears when a pending bid-justification request exists.

effects.does: It switches to the Project Details tab.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record changes; the displayed project-details stage changes.
effects.check: Click Project Details and verify that the project details view is rendered.

effects.does: It switches to the Auction tab.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record changes; the displayed event stage changes to Auction.
effects.check: Click Auction and verify that the Auction stage view is rendered.

effects.does: It keeps or switches the view to the Master QCS tab.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record changes; it selects the Master QCS view.
effects.check: Verify that Master QCS is selected and its contents remain visible.

effects.does: It navigates to the project-level details view.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record changes; only the displayed project screen changes.
effects.check: Click Project and verify that the project details page opens.

effects.does: It opens the selected vendor's bid or proposal details.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record changes; it navigates to the vendor's proposal record for this lot.
effects.leadsTo: vendor proposal or contract details screen
effects.check: Click the vendor column and verify that the corresponding proposal or contract details screen opens based on its status.
